description: This file defines a Java servlet named Receip that handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve and display sale details based on an order ID parameter.

classes.name: Receip
classes.description: A servlet that processes requests to fetch sale details for a specific order ID and forwards the information to a JSP page for display.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve sale details based on the OID parameter, manages errors, and forwards data to Sales.jsp for presentation.
